texts.A partire se il lettore di schede è rile: Start when the card reader is detected
texts.Al termine della giornata lavorativa, no: At the end of the working day no rest period was entered
texts.Almeno una è molto grave: controlla la s: At least one is very serious: check the Infringements tab.
texts.Brevi pause (<15 min) non sono considera: Short breaks (<15 min) are not counted as work
texts.Controllo del veicolo prima della parten: Vehicle check before departure (duration chosen in the settings).
texts.Dir. 2002/15/CE Art. 4 — orario medio se: Dir. 2002/15/EC Art. 4 — average weekly working time max 48h over the reference period.
texts.Dir. 2002/15/CE Art. 4 — orario settiman: Dir. 2002/15/EC Art. 4 — weekly working time max 60h.
texts.Dir. 2002/15/CE Art. 5 — non si può lavo: Dir. 2002/15/EC Art. 5 — no more than 6 consecutive hours of work without a break.
texts.Dir. 2002/15/CE Art. 5 — oltre 6h di lav: Dir. 2002/15/EC Art. 5 — over 6h of work at least 30 min of break are required.
texts.Dir. 2002/15/CE Art. 5 — oltre 9h di lav: Dir. 2002/15/EC Art. 5 — over 9h of work at least 45 min of break are required.
texts.Dir. 2002/15/CE Art. 7 — con lavoro nott: Dir. 2002/15/EC Art. 7 — with night work the daily working time may not exceed 10h.
texts.Durante il periodo di riposo la carta er: During the rest period the card was in the tachograph
texts.Errore durante la lettura della carta. R: Error while reading the card. Try again or restart the reader.
texts.Fuso usato per mostrare orari e giorni: Time zone used to show times and days
texts.I file .DDD vengono caricati nella carte: The .DDD files are uploaded to the TachoVision folder of your cloud storage.
texts.Il conducente non è in riposo all'istant: The driver is not resting at the reference time.
texts.Il lavoro notturno non limita l'orario d: Night work does not limit the daily working time
texts.Il periodo mensile va dal giorno N al gi: The monthly period runs from day N to day N-1
texts.Il periodo è stato conteggiato come ripo: The period was counted as rest, the surrounding evaluation is uncertain
texts.Il simbolo del paese deve essere inserit: The country symbol must be entered at the beginning and at the end of the rest period
texts.Il tempo trascorso sul traghetto/in tren: The time spent on the ferry/train was probably not a rest in a cabin (berth)
texts.Il timestamp del download non verrà scri: The download timestamp will not be written to the card ⚠️
texts.Il timestamp del download sarà scritto s: The download timestamp will be written to the card
texts.Il veicolo non è stato ispezionato prima: The vehicle was not inspected before departure
texts.Impossibile leggere il file. Verifica ch: Unable to read the file. Check that it is a valid .DDD file.

The driver did not work outside the base country during the recorded period.

texts.L'inserimento della tessera non influisc: Inserting the card does not affect the start of working time
texts.L'orario di lavoro inizia quando si inse: Working time starts when the card is inserted
texts.L'orario di lavoro inizia solo con la pr: Working time only starts with the first activity ⚠️
texts.L'orario di lavoro massimo è di 10 ore: The maximum working time is 10 hours
texts.La carta del conducente non è stata scar: The driver card was not downloaded within 28 days
texts.La disponibilità non interrompe il lavor: Availability does not interrupt continuous work
texts.La disponibilità può essere considerata: Availability may be considered a break
texts.Lavorare più di 10 ore al giorno, lavora: Working more than 10 hours a day while also working at night.
texts.Lavoro continuo per più di 6 ore: Continuous work for more than 6 hours
texts.Le pause brevi non sono incluse nell'ora: Short breaks are not included in working time ⚠️
texts.Le pause brevi sono incluse nell'orario: Short breaks are included in working time
texts.Lettura di dati di tipo G2v2 (inclusi G1: Read G2v2 data (including G1 and G2v1)

texts.Nelle ultime 8 settimane nessuna è molto: None in the last 8 weeks is very serious.

texts.Non è stato specificato il tipo di attiv: The previous activity type was not specified when the card was inserted
texts.Ogni pausa viene pagata (tranne i 45 min: Every break is paid (except the required 45 min)
texts.Ore di lavoro accreditate per ogni giorn: Working hours credited for each holiday

texts.Periodo di riferimento per la media di 4: Reference period for the 48-hour weekly average
texts.Periodo di riposo giornaliero insufficie: Insufficient daily rest period of less than 11 hours where no reduced daily rest is allowed
Insufficient daily rest period of less than 9 hours in multi-manning
texts.Periodo di riposo giornaliero ridotto in: Insufficient reduced daily rest period of less than 9 hours where the reduction is allowed
texts.Periodo di riposo giornaliero suddiviso: Insufficient split daily rest period of less than 3+9 hours
texts.Periodo di riposo insufficiente settiman: Insufficient weekly rest period taken after twelve consecutive 24-hour periods
texts.Periodo di riposo settimanale avviato tr: Weekly rest period started too late
texts.Periodo di riposo settimanale insufficie: Insufficient weekly rest period of less than 45 hours where no reduced weekly rest is allowed
texts.Periodo di riposo settimanale non più di: Weekly rest period no later than every 12 days
Weekly rest period no later than every 6 days
texts.Periodo di riposo settimanale ridotto in: Insufficient reduced weekly rest period of less than 24 hours
texts.Possibile deroga Art. 12: il turno termi: Possible Art. 12 derogation: the shift ends with the weekly rest in the base country. To reach the operating centre or the place of residence driving may be exceeded by 1 hour (2 hours with a 30-minute break before), writing the reason by hand on the printout and compensating by the end of the third week.
texts.Probabilmente ha trascorso in un veicolo: A long rest period was probably spent in a vehicle
texts.Reg. 165/2014 Art. 34§3 — al reinserimen: Reg. 165/2014 Art. 34§3 — when the card is inserted again the activities carried out without the card must be entered manually.
texts.Reg. 165/2014 Art. 34§5 — a fine giornat: Reg. 165/2014 Art. 34§5 — at the end of the day rest must be selected on the tachograph.
texts.Reg. 165/2014 Art. 34§6(f) — il simbolo: Reg. 165/2014 Art. 34§6(f) — the country symbol must be entered at the beginning and at the end of the daily working period.
texts.Reg. 165/2014 Art. 34§7 — dal 02/02/2022: Reg. 165/2014 Art. 34§7 — since 02/02/2022 the country must also be entered when crossing a border.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 4(g) — riposo frazion: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 4(g) — split rest: first 3h, then 9h.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 6§1 — anche nei giorn: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 6§1 — even on extended days daily driving may not exceed 10h.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 6§1 — guida giornalie: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 6§1 — daily driving max 9h; 10h at most twice a week.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 6§3 — guida in due se: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 6§3 — driving in two consecutive weeks max 90h.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 7 (servizi occasional: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 7 (occasional bus services) — between 22 and 6, in multi-manning, break after 3h of driving.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 7 — dopo 4h30 di guid: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 7 — after 4h30 of driving a break of at least 45 min is required, which may be split into 15 + 30 min.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§2 — riposo giornali: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§2 — regular daily rest of 11h within 24h of the end of the previous rest.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§4 — riposo ridotto: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§4 — reduced rest at least 9h, at most 3 times between two weekly rests.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§5 — in multipresenz: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§5 — in multi-manning 9h of rest within 30h.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6 (dal 20/08/2020): Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6 (since 20/08/2020) — in international goods transport two consecutive reduced weekly rests abroad are allowed only if compensated before the following weekly rest and with at least 4 weekly rests (2 regular) in 4 weeks.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6 — il riposo setti: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6 — the weekly rest must start within 6 periods of 24h from the previous one.
Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6 — the reduced weekly rest may not be shorter than 24h.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6 — in 2 settimane: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6 — in 2 consecutive weeks 2 regular rests of 45h are required, or 1 regular and 1 reduced (≥ 24h).
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6a — dopo la deroga: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6a — after the 12-day derogation longer rests are required.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6a — servizi occasi: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§6a — occasional bus services: derogation up to 12 periods of 24h.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§8 (dal 20/08/2020): Reg. 561/2006 Art. 8§8 (since 20/08/2020) — the regular weekly rest may not be taken in the vehicle.
texts.Reg. 561/2006 Art. 9 — il riposo su trag: Reg. 561/2006 Art. 9 — rest on a ferry or train only counts if the driver has access to a sleeper cabin or couchette.
texts.Reg. UE 581/2010 — i dati della carta de: Reg. EU 581/2010 — driver card data must be downloaded at least every 28 days.

texts.Sei sicuro di voler ripristinare tutte l: Are you sure you want to restore all settings to their default values?
